source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: Using the new domain you want for the campaign, could you create an email and share its login details with me?

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hello Caleb Hart! I hope you’re doing well today. Sorry about the long delay—I’ve now set up the alternative-domain email. What should we do next?

execution.observed_behavior: Client reports that the email account on the alternative campaign domain has been set up.
Authentication to the campaign-domain mailbox failed with the supplied password.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: The version with a lowercase k worked; you had entered that K as a capital.

execution.observed_behavior: The freelancer successfully authenticated to the campaign-domain mailbox after using the correctly capitalized password.

routing_warnings.description: Mailreach rejecting the mailbox password concerns connecting the mailbox to the warm-up service rather than creating or configuring the mailbox itself.
The invalid-email access block concerns the paid warm-up service and should not be treated as a failure of the campaign-domain mailbox.
The request to integrate the email with MeetAlfred and HubSpot belongs to the separate cross-platform email-integration Requirement.
